name: Formation.Fi
rootCause: DeFi protocol Formation.Fi was attacked by flash loans. The main reason for this incident is that the project party underestimated the impact of fee on totalTokens when designing the function swapIn, and ignored the impact of decimal point accuracy between different tokens.
